@everyone CHARITY STREAM FOR LINDEN COMMUNITY PANTRY — Saturday, Nov 21, 10am–10pm (12 hours, yes i know)

I’m posting and pinning this early because last year we raised $212 and half the server didn’t hear about it until basically the day of, since I posted so late. Y’all still did that with almost no warning lol. This year the goal is $600, and @tj_rook is matching the first $100 donated, so the first $100 counts double.

Donation page: lindenpantry.example/mrkz

It goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off. Through their wholesale partner, every $1 gets about 4 pounds of food. They’re serving around 340 families a week right now, and the shelves are really low going into Thanksgiving.

Even $3 helps. But if you can’t give, seriously, no guilt. Sharing the stream, showing up, joining lobbies and keeping chat alive all matter. No card? All of that still counts, and if you’re local you can also drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays, 9–1.

Incentives (based on our total):
$100 — I play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and I dye it ON STREAM
$400 — one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry; donations go to the pantry and they buy the food

First half is community lobbies, anyone can join and I’ll drop the code. Second half, chat votes on a game every two hours. No twelve hours of the same map, promise.

And for the “charity streams are cringe” people: it’s not begging if you get hair dye content out of it lol. Come hang for ten minutes or all day, and let’s actually get this one in front of people before the last second.

devon fair enough if charity streams aren’t your thing lol, but nobody’s getting pressured. if me doing upside-down controller rounds and possibly terrible hair helps stock a food pantry, i can live with being cringe for a day.

and paige, yep, you can absolutely help without a card: share the announcement or stream, show up, join a lobby, or if you’re local bring canned/boxed food to the pantry’s blue bin Saturdays 9–1. donating is never the price of hanging out here.
